| Sanofi | Scientist Organic Chemist, Process Chemistry | Montpellier | Posted Yesterday | remote | internship | junior |  | Pharmaceutical | Le contenu du poste est libellé en anglais car il nécessite de nombreuses interactions avec nos filiales à l'international, l'anglais étant la langue de travail. Job title : Scientist Organic Chemist, Process Chemistry Location: Montpellier About the job As a bench-level Organic Chemist within our Commercial Process Development team, you'll lead the design and optimization of cutting-edge synthetic routes and process chemistry strategies to accelerate pharmaceutical manufacturing at Sanofi. From developing innovative synthetic pathways to ensuring safe and successful scale-up from laboratory to pilot plant, your expertise will directly shape the future of life-changing medicine development at Sanofi. Ready to take on the challenge? Join our Montpellier R&D site , one of Sanofi's most dynamic hubs for pharmaceutical innovation. As part of a multicultural and forward-thinking team, you'll drive high-impact process chemistry projects, collaborate with cross-functional teams across Chemistry and Manufacturing networks, and lead the optimization of synthetic routes throughout our development pipeline. Whether it's conducting rapid reaction screening, designing DoE experiments, or mentoring junior scientists, you'll be at the heart of Sanofi's mission to chase the miracles of science — with real career growth opportunities in a collaborative and innovative environment. About Sanofi: We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system, and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. Main responsibilities: Design, develop, and optimize synthetic routes for active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) using the right technology to allow smooth and rapid scale-up to pilot-scale operations Plan and conduct organic synthesis experiments and chemical reactions in the laboratory, with proficiency in analytical characterization techniques Support technology transfer to manufacturing sites and troubleshoot technical issues at the interface of chemistry and manufacturing Serve as the primary technical contact within the team, anticipating challenges and implementing proactive measures Mentor junior scientists and offer technical leadership and guidance to the team Document all experimental work in digital lab notebooks and compile findings into comprehensive technical reports Oversee the proper maintenance and operational readiness of specific scientific equipment Communicate complex technical information clearly and effectively to multidisciplinary audiences and stakeholders What we offer you: Competitive compensation package Fixed salary over 12 months, complement by individual variable compensation plus profit-sharing based on Sanofi Group results. Comprehensive benefits because caring for our employees is also our mission 31 days of paid vacation + additional time off according to your status, remote work up to 2 days per week, quality health insurance, public transportation coverage up to 80%; extended maternity leave (18 weeks) and child welcome leave (14 weeks), Savings Plan & Retirement Plans with company matching, employee committee benefits, internal and international mobility opportunities, personalized training programs to support you throughout your career, and many other benefits to discover here. About you Experience : Proven experience in synthetic organic chemistry and process development. Demonstrated ability to translate laboratory processes to pilot/industrial scale. Experienced in working on different types of chemical modalities i.e. small molecules, peptides, lipids. Soft and technical skills : Organic Chemistry & Synthesis: designing and executing synthetic routes, understanding reaction mechanisms, troubleshooting chemical processes Analytical Skills: chemical analysis techniques, chromatography (HPLC, GC), spectroscopy (NMR, MS, IR), data interpretation Strong data management and analysis skills Technical Problem-Solving: process troubleshooting, root cause analysis, risk assessment, solution development Experience with digital lab notebooks, or reaction databases Excellent communication and teamwork skills; ability to thrive in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary environment Education : MSc in Organic Chemistry, Process Chemistry, or related field, with a strong academic record and proven expertise in synthetic organic chemistry Languages :  English and French, both fluent Why choose us? Drive innovation at the intersection of chemistry, digital science, robotics and scale-up Accelerate the path from discovery to clinic for life-changing medicines Collaborate with leading scientists, engineers, and digital experts Access to state-of-the-art AI, automation, and robotics platforms Accelerate your professional development with structured career paths designed for both scientific and leadership advancement. Grow in ways you never imagined through bold moves that stretch your potential, cross moves into other business areas, and short-term gigs that build your scientific expertise Join a workplace where diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the core, with Employee Resource Groups and leadership programs that celebrate every voice Achieve genuine work-life balance in a supportive R&D environment Enjoy outstanding benefits, including flexible working options, comprehensive healthcare, and well-being programs designed to help you thrive Pursue Progress . Job title : Senior Scientist – Drug Product Design Location: Montpellier, France About the job As Senior Scientist Drug Product Design within our CMC (Chemistry Manufacturing and Control) formulation laboratory , you'll drive the design and development of solid dosage forms from lab to industrial scale. You'll be at the heart of pharmaceutical innovation, transforming molecules into medicines that reach patients worldwide. Ready to get started? Our Drug Product Design (DPD) department is a Center of Excellence within Sanofi R&D, specializing in orally administered synthetic molecules. We lead formulation development across all stages — from preclinical to commercial — ensuring seamless transfer from pilot clinical batches to industrial production and regulatory submission. Here, deep immunoscience meets bold, AI-powered research to accelerate drug discovery and turn the impossible into possible for millions of patients and their families. About Sanofi: We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system and innovative pipeline, enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. Main responsibilities: Design and optimize oral formulations from preclinical through regulatory filling, including manufacturing processes from laboratory to industrial scale. Lead, supervise or conduct laboratory trials, planning, execution and interpretation of results with high scientific rigor. Write and supervise internal and external study documents (protocols, electronic workbooks, scientific and transfer reports) Contribute to scale-up transfers to GMP operations and Manufacturing & Supply. Manage cross-functional teams of formulation technicians and collaborate effectively with CMC partners (Biopharmacy, Process Engineering, GMP Manufacturing, Analytics and Chemistry teams) to ensure project success. Drive predictive modelling and advanced data analysis (DoE, statistics) to optimize development processes. Develop innovative automation solutions and support implementation of IA tools within the department. What we offer you: Competitive compensation package Fixed salary over 12 months, complemented by individual variable compensation , plus profit sharing based on Sanofi Group results. Comprehensive benefits because caring for our employees is also our mission 31 days of paid vacation + additional time off according to your status, remote work up to 2 days per week, quality health insurance, public transportation coverage up to 80%; extended maternity leave (18 weeks) and child welcome leave (14 weeks), Savings Plan & Retirement Plans with company matching, employee committee benefits, internal and international mobility opportunities, personalized training programs to support you throughout your career, and many other benefits to discover here. About you Experience : Approximately 5 years of experience in pharmaceutical development, with expertise in solid oral dosage forms and associated technologies and equipment. Experience in technology transfer in clinical or industrial manufacturing. Technical skills : Strong understanding of pharmaceutical formulation and excipients, pharmaceutical engineering, process scale-up and optimization. Knowledge of fundamental biopharmaceutical principles. Good knowledge of predictive modeling and data analysis; familiarity with simulation tools. Soft skills and know-how: Focused on results with strong organizational skills and strong interest in science. Good interpersonal skills and excellent communication and presentation abilities. Team-oriented, dynamic and proactive with problem solving skills Simplification abilities and affinity for IA tools implementation Education : PhD, PharmD or Master’s degree, with specialization in formulation Languages : Fluent in French, written and spoken English Why choose us? Be part of a pioneering biopharma company that engages patients early in drug development and uses their insights to design studies that reflect real-world needs. Work at the forefront of drug discovery, harnessing cutting-edge AI, data, and digital platforms to push the boundaries of science. The Global Clinical Immunology (GCI) organization, part of Late Stage Global Immunology within Vaccines R&D, specializes in developing, validating, and deploying regulated bioanalytical assays to assess immune responses to vaccines throughout their lifecycle. Our GCLP-compliant bioanalytical laboratories are based in Swiftwater, PA This role will ensure high-quality, consistent, and compliant data, managing a team responsible for developing, validating, and implementing immunological ligand-binding methods that support clinical endpoints across vaccine trials from Phase I through Phase IV. The scientists will contribute scientific insights to projects, ensure all documentation aligns with project standards, and oversee compliance with quality and safety guidelines. They may lead team members, collaborate on scientific teams, and evaluate technologies to continually improve laboratory methods. The Senior lab manager will be instrumental in fostering a high standard of laboratory operations and scientific rigor. About Sanofi: We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. Main Responsibilities: Define and articulate short and long-term access strategies, ensuring clear communication of strategic rationale, objectives, and success metrics across all stakeholder groups. Develop comprehensive market access strategy frameworks that integrate payer insights, competitive intelligence, and brand positioning to optimize patient access. Create and deliver strategic presentations and communications to leadership, cross-functional teams, and external partners. Lead the development of compelling value propositions and messaging frameworks that demonstrate Rezurock's clinical and economic value to diverse payer audiences. Partner with HEVA/RWE teams to translate clinical evidence into accessible value communications and market access tools. Design and implement communication strategies that effectively convey complex pricing, contracting, and access information to internal and external stakeholders. Serve as the primary access strategy liaison across Marketing, Market Access Shared Services, HEVA/RWE, manufacturing, logistics, and field sales teams to ensure coordinated strategy execution. Lead cross-functional strategy sessions and working groups to align on access priorities, resolve strategic challenges, and optimize resource allocation. Facilitate strategic decision-making processes by providing access expertise and market insights to inform brand strategy and tactical execution. Provide strategic direction and support to field-based teams to enhance their ability to communicate access strategies and overcome market access barriers. Develop field enablement tools, training materials, and strategic guidance to empower teams in patient access discussions. Monitor field feedback and market intelligence to continuously refine access strategies and communication approaches. Serve as a key strategic advisor to the Senior Director, providing analytical support, strategic recommendations, and operational execution for transplant portfolio initiatives. Represent the transplant team in cross-functional meetings and strategic discussions as needed. Support portfolio-level strategic planning and decision-making processes through comprehensive market access analysis and recommendations. Monitor marketplace dynamics, competitive threats, and emerging opportunities to inform strategic planning and tactical adjustments. Generate actionable customer insights through systematic analysis of payer trends, policy changes, and market access challenges. Partner with global market access teams to ensure alignment on strategy development and share best practices across markets. About You Basic Qualifications: Bachelor's degree is required. Minimum of 7 + years’ relevant professional experience including market access, health economics, pricing & reimbursement. 7 + years’ experience at local and/or international level w/ knowledge of US and Global market access & payer environment. Proven experience in strategy development and communication across complex organizational structures. Knowledge of disease market access is desirable, but other backgrounds are welcomed. Preferred Qualifications: Demonstrated success in leading strategic initiatives within matrix organizations without direct reporting authority. Exceptional written and oral communication skills with proven ability to translate complex strategies into clear, actionable communications. Strong track record of developing and delivering compelling value propositions and strategic presentations to diverse audiences. Experience in indirect leadership and field team enablement. Ability to synthesize complex business problems into strategic solutions and communicate recommendations effectively across all organizational levels. Why Choose Us? Within this organization, the Contract Assurance team is Sanofi’s post-signature capability within Contract Excellence (part of Global Procurement Services) that ensures supplier commercial commitments are executed as intended and value is realized, through targeted contract assurance reviews (e.g. supplier contract audits) and ongoing monitoring enabled by standardized processes, tools, and analytics. Reporting to a Contract Assurance Reviews Audit Director, the Audit Manager is responsible for executing audit assignments that help Sanofi validate supplier compliance, identify value recovery opportunities, and strengthen supplier governance. They will work in close collaboration with internal stakeholders and be actively involved in projects that shape the future of our audit practice. Responsibilities Audit Execution Participate in the planning and execution of supplier audits focused on contract compliance, performance, and financial integrity. Analyze supplier and Sanofi documentation to detect risks, discrepancies, or missed value. Prepare clear, well-supported audit findings and quantify financial and operational impacts. Engage with both internal stakeholders (Procurement, Legal, Finance, Business Units) and external suppliers to validate findings and support resolution. Progressively lead selected audit assignments, managing scope, timelines, and stakeholder communications. Track implementation of corrective actions and follow up on outcomes. Risk & Improvement Opportunities Contribute to supplier targeting using a risk-based approach informed by spend, contract content, performance indicators, and data trends. Identify and recommend improvements to contract wording or internal monitoring practices to enhance enforceability, value realization, and risk control. Help integrate audit learnings into source-to-pay and supplier relationship management activities. Team & Project Contributions Participate in cross-functional projects aimed at enhancing audit tools, processes, and methodologies (e.g., Power BI dashboards, AI pilots, audit playbooks). Contribute to the team’s continuous improvement by testing new solutions and documenting best practices. Support the development of internal templates, training materials, and knowledge-sharing tools. Collaboration & Communication Build collaborative relationships with global teams and supplier representatives. Support audit debriefs and presentations to internal audiences, helping translate findings into actionable improvements. Reinforce supplier accountability and better contract execution through insights and engagement. About you Required A BA/BS degree in Accounting, Finance, or other business discipline. 3+ years of prior experience in audit (internal or external), forensic auditing, contract compliance. Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with attention to detail Fluent in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong team player able to thrive in an autonomous work environment, with the agility to navigate across diverse projects and topics while working remotely from the core team. Comfortable working across cultures and time zones in a matrixed, global environment. Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word); experience with data tools like Power BI, Qlik, Tableau or ERPs (e.g. SAP) is a plus. Willingness to travel internationally up to 20% (typically for 1–2 week periods). Preferred Experience with a Big Four firm or similar consulting environment. Background in healthcare and/or life-science industry. Familiarity with contract language and legal/financial terminology. Experience in developing written reports and delivering presentations. Global or international experience and ability to work with a diverse team. Multilingual (verbal and written). Exposure to AI-driven audit or data automation tools. #LI-Hybrid #BarcelonaHub #SanofiHubs Pursue progress , discover extraordinary Better is out there. About the job As AWS Cloud Engineer within our Cloud Engineering team, you'll design and build the cloud foundation that powers Sanofi's most critical solutions. From evolving our AWS Landing Zone to enabling teams across the organization to leverage cloud at scale, you'll be a key enabler of innovation — championing infrastructure-as-code practices and engineering excellence every step of the way. Ready to get started? Our Cloud Engineering team is made up of passionate cloud experts who own the AWS Landing Zone and its foundational services. We work hand-in-hand with infrastructure and application teams, supporting cloud migration journeys and helping build cloud-native solutions. It's a collaborative, forward-thinking environment where your ideas shape how a global biopharma company harnesses the power of the cloud. Main responsibilities Design and build cloud foundations — Own the AWS Landing Zone and core cloud services, ensuring they are secure, scalable, and ready to support business-critical workloads (400 AWS accounts). Develop reusable infrastructure components — Write and maintain modular infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, building a library of standardised, reusable modules that accelerate delivery across teams. Automate deployments end-to-end — Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate cloud provisioning, configuration management, and service deployment reliably and at scale. Embed security and compliance by design — Implement cloud security controls, access policies, and network safeguards to ensure every deployment meets Sanofi's standards and regulatory requirements. Keep the platform visible and reliable — Set up monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions so teams have full visibility into platform health and can respond quickly when issues arise. Contribute to cloud migration initiatives — Guide the migration of on-premises workloads to AWS, minimizing disruption while applying cloud architecture best practices throughout. Enable and uplift cloud capability — Act as a trusted technical advisor for engineering teams, sharing knowledge on cloud patterns, best practices, and tools to raise the bar across the organisation. About you Cloud expertise — Deep, hands-on experience with AWS services and cloud architecture, with a strong ability to design scalable and resilient solutions. Infrastructure as code mindset — Strong proficiency in Terraform (including module development), CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions preferred), and automation tooling such as Ansible. Security and networking know-how — Solid understanding of AWS security principles, IAM, networking concepts, and compliance controls. Collaborative and communicative — You thrive in cross-functional environments, can explain complex technical concepts clearly, and enjoy helping others grow their cloud skills. Engineering excellence advocate — You treat infrastructure like software — tested, versioned, and continuously improved — and bring a DevOps culture wherever you go. Nice to have — AWS certifications and/or hands-on experience leading cloud migration projects are a plus. Why choose us? Make a global impact — Your work directly supports solutions that help improve the lives of patients around the world. Grow your career — Access world-class learning opportunities, mentorship, and a clear path for professional development within a global organisation. Inclusive culture — Join a diverse, welcoming team where every perspective is valued and everyone is empowered to contribute. Innovation at the core — Work in an environment that embraces bold ideas and cutting-edge technology to solve real-world challenges. Work with the latest cloud technologies — Get hands-on with modern AWS services and tooling at enterprise scale. Shape cloud strategy — Play a key role in defining how a global biopharma leader builds and evolves its cloud foundations. Sanofi is dedicated to chasing the miracles of science to improve people's lives. As a Patient Experience Salesforce Advanced Therapy Management (ATM) Engineer, you will play a critical role in development, unit testing, deployment and code quality management that directly support our patient services mission. This position combines deep technical expertise in Salesforce ATM with a strong commitment to patient privacy, data security, and healthcare compliance standards. Main Responsibilities A Salesforce Advanced Therapy Management (ATM) role involves configuring and developing solutions for multiple therapies, focusing on patient management, multi-step scheduling (apheresis, manufacturing, infusion), therapy orchestration (using Salesforce Flows), and integrating with 3rd party systems, streamline the patient journeys from enrollment to treatment, requiring technical skills in Apex, Lightning, and deep functional knowledge of Healthcare Cloud processes. Key Responsibilities: Salesforce Development & Configuration: Designing, building, and customizing ATM applications, Apex classes, Triggers, Lightning Components, Visualforce, Flows, and Process Builders. Therapy Orchestration: Implementing complex, multi-step therapy workflows (e.g., apheresis, infusion) using Salesforce Flows and defining stages, steps, and tasks. Multi-Step Scheduling: Configuring and managing Salesforce Scheduler for booking appointments across different sites/territories for therapy steps. Integration: Developing integrations with 3rd party tools for therapy orchestration. Data Management: Managing participant data, clinical info, enrollment progress, and ensuring data integrity for complex care journeys. User & Role Management: Setting up user profiles, permission sets, and ensuring proper access for business end users, coordinators, and other roles. Reporting & Compliance: Configuring COI/COC (Chain of Identity/Custody) reporting and tracking. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features. Troubleshoot and resolve software defects and issues. Ensure performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications. Stay updated with the latest industry trends and technologies to drive innovation. Healthcare Compliance and Patient Data Protection Maintain strict adherence to Sanofi Patient Services standards and compliance requirements. Ensure all solutions comply with PHI (Protected Health Information) and PII (Personally Identifiable Information) regulations. Implement GDPR-compliant data handling, storage, and processing practices. Maintain patient data safety and privacy as the highest priority in all technical decisions. Participate in compliance audits and implement remediation actions as needed. Stay current with healthcare data regulations including HIPAA, GDPR, and other applicable standards. About You Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field. Minimum of 6 years of experience in software development. Strong Salesforce platform expertise (Admin & Dev). Proficiency in Healthcare Cloud, especially the Advanced Therapy Management data model. Experience with Salesforce Scheduler, Flows, Apex, and Lightning. Experience with Evaluation flows, platform events, CDC, REST, SOAP API & bulk API is required Understanding of advance therapy processes and patient journeys. Ability to work with cross-functional teams (clinical, IT, business). Knowledge of Agent force is desirable Excellent communication and teamwork abilities. Ability to work in a fast-paced and collaborative environment. Familiarity with CI/CD tools and practices to streamline development and deployment workflows. Why choose us? Healthcare Compliance and Patient Data Protection Maintain strict adherence to Sanofi Patient Services standards and compliance requirements. Ensure all solutions comply with PHI (Protected Health Information) and PII (Personally Identifiable Information) regulations. Implement GDPR-compliant data handling, storage, and processing practices. Maintain patient data safety and privacy as the highest priority in all technical decisions. Participate in compliance audits and implement remediation actions as needed. Stay current with healthcare data regulations including HIPAA, GDPR, and other applicable standards. About You Bachelor’s degree in computer science, or in Engineering, or a related field. Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in software development. Salesforce Expertise: Strong knowledge of Health Cloud features, data models (patient/insurance), and core Salesforce. Technical Skills: Proficiency in Apex, LWC, Visualforce, Salesforce APIs, Triggers, Flow builder, OmniStudio and platform security. Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Understanding of provider/payer processes, US healthcare ecosystem, and compliance. Soft Skills: Excellent communication, problem-solving, leadership, and stakeholder management. Managing version control and repositories for Salesforce projects. Providing technical support and guidance to Salesforce users. Reviewing and merging work in source control. Development knowledge in Salesforce Health Cloud, CSS, JavaScript, LWC, VSCode, and GitHub Knowledge of Agent force is desirable Excellent communication and teamwork abilities. Ability to work in a fast-paced and collaborative environment. Familiarity with CI/CD tools and practices to streamline development and deployment workflows. Main Responsibilities We are looking for a skilled Software Test Automation Engineer with strong exposure to the Salesforce Health Cloud ecosystem, and automation frameworks. The ideal candidate will have at least 5-8 years of experience in software test automation and/or software development and keen experience working within various automation frameworks and programming languages such as Java, Python and Robotic Testing. Key Responsibilities: Primary Responsibility: Designing, developing, and maintaining automated test scripts for web applications, with a focus and expertise using implementing Copado Robotic Testing and/or Selenium test script development. Managing/taking ownership of the Copado Robotic Testing platform. Salesforce: Deep understanding of the Salesforce Lightning and OmniStudio ecosystem to support automated testing for seasonal releases, and multiple Salesforce lower environments. Devops Methodologies: Contributing to the continuous improvement of our CI/CD pipelines by identifying and integrating automated tests. Collaboration: Work closely with functional test teams, development teams and business partners to understand new features and identify automatable components. Technical Expertise: Develop test automation scripts using Copado Robotic Testing disciplines, proven Python programming language expertise, exposure to open-source frameworks such as Selenium, comprehension of JAVA programming language. Data Integrity: Exposure to automating Snowflake driven applications and data integrity models is helpful. Defect Triage Methodologies: Through automation, detecting, isolating, documenting, and validating software defects using internal testing tools and sound defect triage methodologies. Agile/Scrum Experience: Work closely with scrum masters, product owners and manual test teams to establish and maintain stories, tasks and defects in JIRA to ensure delivery of operational and project work items as related to automation Performance & Support: Optimize automation performance, troubleshoot complex issues, and provide automation support for various deployments. Stay updated with the latest industry trends and technologies to drive innovation. About You Bachelor’s degree in computer science, or in Engineering, or a related field or equivalent experience. Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in test software automation development. Exposure to Copado Robotic Testing or OCR based automation test tools. Proven expertise in building and maintaining automated test scripts/suites using OCR automation models. Experience working with hybrid object/data Selenium models is also beneficial. Experience with source code control, build, and CI/CD toolchains, specifically Git/GitHub, and familiarity with tools like Jenkins, Maven, GitHub actions, AWS or similar. Experience automating or developing test scripts within the Salesforce lightning and/or OmniStudio environments. Experience with Jira and XRay, or similar project and test management applications. Keen attention to detail and accuracy. Exhibit a high level of initiative and ability to work independently as well as within a team setting. Collaborating with functional test teams to design, build, and optimize automated test scripts/solutions and reporting. Expertise in monitoring automation performance and troubleshooting issues. Ensuring compliance with security and regulatory requirements. Test Automation/Development knowledge in Salesforce Health Cloud, Python, REST API, Java and GitHub Excellent communication and teamwork abilities. | Sanofi | Sanofi Manufacturing Innovators Program _MSAT Scientist Trainee | City of Singapore | Posted 2 Days Ago | onsite | internship | junior |  | Pharmaceutical | About the job We deliver 4.3 billion healthcare solutions to people every year, thanks to the flawless planning and meticulous eye for detail of our Manufacturing & Supply teams. With your talent and ambition, we can do even more to protect people from infectious diseases and bring hope to patients and their families. In partnership with EDB, we are hiring talented young Talents to join our Biologics manufacturing facility. In this dedicated program, you will be trained in our state-of-the art manufacturing facilities at our Massachusetts Biocampus (MBC) in Framingham, Massachusetts, United States. You will be expected to commit at least 12 months and to up to 18 months to be based in United States. Manufacturing Science and Analytical Technology (MSAT) is a global function which drives the industrialization and the improvement of biological processes and products. It embarks new technologies and digital trends. It is the keeper of manufacturing process knowledge. MSAT is at the crossroad of R&D and production. It is a multi-disciplinary function that provides expertise in process, manufacturing sciences, process modeling, statistical analysis, process validation and technology transfer. Your job, as MSAT Scientist Trainee within our Sanofi MSAT department in Singapore, will be to gain and develop hands-on expertise in upstream or downstream development/scale-down activities, pilot-scale and manufacturing sciences. At MBC, the trainees will work on both new projects and ongoing activities supporting new molecule introduction, technology transfer and process investigations. With the strong network and technical expertise build in MBC, the trainees will greatly contribute to create & prepare the MSAT laboratory to aid technology transfer, troubleshooting and continuous improvement activities when they return to Singapore. Main responsibilities: · Receive training in scientific concepts and hands-on techniques of appropriate upstream or downstream bioprocess equipment (integrated continuous biomanufacturing when possible), in order to carry out activities independently. · Work with appointed mentor (or delegate) to support or (co)author straightforward MSAT technical documents (e.g. protocols, reports, memos) to support (i) new product development, (ii) second generation process development, (iii) scale-down studies for investigation purposes, (iv) technology transfer, (v) process improvements. · Be familiar with daily MSAT lab operations. · Contribute to technology transfer/ MSAT lab project by supporting receiving unit and sending unit MSAT representatives in knowledge transfer and compilation/drafting of documentation. · Support deliverables leading to the CAPEX project stage-gates and operational readiness of receiving unit’s MSAT lab. · Arrange check-in’s with mentor (or delegate) and participate in appropriate team meetings to (i) track and review project progress, (ii) receive training and coaching on bioprocess know-how and navigating business settings. · Share learnings and project progress by connecting with Singapore team regularly. · Build and promote systems and tools for (i) standardization concepts & implementation, (ii) sharing and retention of design knowledge, within site and Sanofi network. About you Education : Masters / Degree in Related Science, Bioengineering, Chemical Engineering graduates preferred · Minimally 2nd upper honors from NUS, NTU, SUTD and SIT Soft and technical skills : An effective communicator and productive in multi-functional & multi-cultural communication settings. Has excellent analytical, consultative and diagnostic skills with ability to make sound, data-based decisions. Self-directed and comfortable working with a high level of autonomy, for initiating activities to close gaps and complete assigned tasks. Data-driven and scientifically curious. Experience in data analytics tools like R, JMP, Python, Matlab would be advantageous. Why choose us? Principales responsabilités : Participer à la réalisation des analyses de données, y compris des revues forensiques d'e-mails et de documents Prendre part à la préparation et à la conduite d'entretiens avec les déclarants, les témoins et les mis en cause Contribuer à la rédaction des rapports d'investigation et à la constitution de la documentation associée Aider à la mise à jour du système de gestion des dossiers avec des informations précises et actualisées et à l'analyse des conclusions d'enquête afin d'identifier des tendances et des schémas récurrents Apporter votre support  à la collecte et à l'organisation des éléments de preuve dans le cadre des investigations Collaborer avec l'équipe dans l'utilisation des outils d'eDiscovery et des plateformes d'investigation À propos de vous Compétences techniques et relationnelles : Esprit analytique, organisation, bonne communication. Maîtrise du packOffice. Évolue dans une entreprise engagée où ta voix compte et où ton travail améliore la vie de millions de personnes. Épanouis-toi dans des environnements inclusifs et flexibles qui soutiennent ton bien-être personnel et professionnel. | Sanofi | Medical Science Liason | Barcelona | Posted 2 Days Ago | onsite | internship | junior |  | Pharmaceutical | MSL - Enfermedades Raras Hematológicas (Andalucía) Residencia: Andalucía Acerca de la posición La misión del MSL es ser el referente científico en el campo para los expertos externos y responsables de la toma de decisiones en el diagnóstico y tratamiento de los pacientes con enfermedades raras a nivel regional. El MSL será el responsable de establecer, desarrollar y mantener relaciones científicas duraderas, de alto nivel, con los KOL (Key Opinion Leaders) en su área geográfica. El rol de MSL deberá contribuir, en consonancia con la estrategia médica de su área terapéutica, a la creación de asociaciones constructivas y transversales con interlocutores internos y externos, con el fin de garantizar la difusión y el intercambio de información médico-científica, así como el desarrollo de oportunidades estratégicas de su área terapéutica. Somos un equipo apasionado por la ciencia y por cómo mejoramos la vida de los pacientes con enfermedades raras, centrados en el manejo de enfermedades raras hematológicas y de depósito lisosomal, en continuo crecimiento y transformación, trabajando en un entorno de seguridad psicológica donde todas las opiniones cuentan, con el trabajo transversal como una de nuestras señas de identidad y apostando por una cultura diversa e inclusiva que involucra y desarrolla a las personas para ofrecer resultados sobresalientes. Acerca de Sanofi: Somos una compañía biofarmacéutica impulsada por I+D y potenciada por IA, comprometida con mejorar la vida de las personas y ofrecer un crecimiento sólido. Nuestro profundo conocimiento del sistema inmunitario —y nuestra innovadora cartera de proyectos— nos permite inventar medicamentos y vacunas que tratan y protegen a millones de personas en todo el mundo. Juntos, perseguimos los milagros de la ciencia para mejorar la vida de las personas. Responsabilidades: Ser el REFERENTE CIENTIFICO de la zona Tanto para interlocutor externo como interno. Estar actualizado sobre la información científica de su área terapéutica para el intercambio de información con cliente externo e interno, alineado con la estrategia medica del producto. Entiende y actúa en línea con los estándares y códigos de la compañía, legal y regulatorios. Informa al local safety responsable de cualquier información de acuerdo con los procedimientos de farmacovigilancia de la compañía. RELACION con KOLs / DECISORES regionales Contacto, construcción y mantenimiento de una red de líderes locales que puedan actuar como expertos en la difusión de la evidencia científica más relevante de los productos de la Compañía. Ser el partner estratégico del HCP, interaccionando con ellos para entender su visión, preferencias e intereses y detectar áreas de colaboración para cubrir necesidades alineadas con la estrategia médica en su área de responsabilidad. Implementar un plan médico regional, para asegurar la divulgación de datos y nuevas evidencias basadas en estudios, a decisores e influenciadores presentes en los respectivos ámbitos territoriales de responsabilidad. Comunicación/Información médica de los productos a los Organismos Técnicos de las Comunidades Autónomas / Hospitales, en coordinación con Market Access, MSL Manager / Medical Advisors. Desarrollar el PLAN CLÍNICO LOCAL Detección de oportunidades de desarrollo clínico de los productos de Sanofi y generación de conocimiento en relación con el área terapéutica de responsabilidad. Evaluación de los proyectos independientes propuestos (tanto estudios clínicos como, observacionales o propuestas de investigador entre otros) bajo responsabilidad del área médica en su territorio. Apoyo a los EECC esponsorizados de Sanofi (Fase I-IV): en trabajo coordinado con la CSU realizara actividades de apoyo en site feasibility participando en la selección de centros, reclutamiento y seguimiento de los investigadores de su zona. Seguimiento de la implementación de los proyectos en la zona. FORMACIÓN continuada Proporcionar información y liderar la formación científica a los KOLs de su zona a través de sesiones clínicas, actividades y la ejecución del plan de comunicación médico. Actualización de conocimientos a la red comercial sobre los productos del área, tanto propios como de la competencia, así como de la patología. Dar respuesta a consultas terapéuticas en coordinación con su Manager y Medical Advisor. REUNIONES Y PRESENTACIONES locales Responsable científico, asegurándose del conocimiento por parte de los ponentes de la evidencia científica actualizada. Planificación y desarrollo de estas con los equipos comerciales. Participación en reuniones de la zona, como referente científico en coordinación con comercial y acceso al mercado. Actividades de acceso, dando soporte científico o médico en las actividades relacionadas con acceso en su zona de responsabilidad, siendo el referente científico y asegurando coordinación con la estrategia médica nacional. COMUNICACIÓN Actualización periódica de la evolución de los planes médicos en la zona al Medical Advisor y a su Manager. Dar respuesta a las cuestiones que surgen desde los HCPs, de acuerdo con la legislación local y la normativa de Sanofi, cubriendo sus necesidades en cuanto a datos científicos actualizados, publicaciones de ensayos clínicos, guías clínicas, asegurando que disponen de información de la máxima calidad y actualizada. Apoyar las iniciativas de investigadores sobre publicaciones, presentaciones a congresos alineadas con las estrategias del producto o patología, dando el soporte científico alineado con la estrategia médica de producto y área terapéutica. Asistencia a congresos y reuniones que se determinen, transmitiendo posteriormente la información más relevante. Identificación y recolección de los medical insights para detectar posibles planes de acción. Participar activamente en la elaboración de las presentaciones de Educación Médica en coordinación con el equipo Médico-Marketing del producto y como ponente en las sesiones a realizar en la región. COORDINACIÓN Operar dentro de la estrategia de producto y área terapéutica en colaboración con el Equipo Médico nacional y otras funciones transversales de la compañía (Ventas/Marketing/Acceso…) Compartir actividades con el resto de MSLs (compartir las mejores prácticas) y Medical Advisor, así como los miembros del equipo One Medical de Sanofi. Evaluar actividades de éxito y la viabilidad de implementación en otras zonas/regiones. Comunicación bidireccional con los equipos de ventas/MKT/Acceso. Acerca de ti: Imprescindible experiencia en el área de Rare Blood Disorders (enfermedades raras hematológicas) y experiencia previa en la posición de MSL o departamento médico. Se valorará: experiencia en lanzamiento de productos en el ámbito hospitalario. experiencia en posiciones con implicación médica y/o científica. trabajo en equipos multidisciplinares. Competencias y habilidades requeridas Capacidad para trabajo en equipo y para trabajar en equipos multidisciplinares. Espíritu resolutivo y positivo. Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma e independiente y aptitudes para el autoestudio. Capacidad de Planificación y establecimiento de prioridades. Proactividad e iniciativa. Excelentes habilidades comunicativas. Capacidad de construir relaciones de confianza y de influencia con interlocutores. Capacidad de análisis y síntesis. Clara orientación a resultados, organización y planificación. Simplificación y adaptación al cambio. Habilidades Técnicas Habilidades que le permita trabajar sin dificultad utilizando las herramientas que pone a disposición la Compañía para el ejercicio de sus funciones, análisis y seguimiento de los resultados: Nivel usuario de ofimática. Comunicación efectiva en distintos canales (F2F, reuniones virtuales). Experiencia en la realización de presentaciones científicas. Sugerir de forma proactiva opciones para impulsar la innovación en su territorio. Se valorará conocimiento en herramientas digitales y/o metodología AGILE, uso de IA, ... Formación Licenciado en Ciencias de la Salud. Se valorarán estudios de postgrado (MBA, Doctorado o similar). Idiomas: Nivel alto de inglés y Castellano, tanto en comprensión como en expresión oral y escrita. Pursue progress , discover extraordinary Better is out there. | Sanofi | Clinical Operational Data Steward Leader | Budapest | Posted 2 Days Ago | hybrid | internship | junior |  | Pharmaceutical | Job title: Operational Data Steward Leader Location: Budapest, Hungary Job type: Permanent, full-time Hybrid working About the job Are you ready to shape the future of medicine? The race is on to speed up drug discovery and development to find answers for patients and their families. Your skills could be critical in helping our teams accelerate progress. We are an innovative global healthcare company with one purpose: to chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. We’re also a company where you can flourish and grow your career, with countless opportunities to explore, make connections with people, and stretch the limits of what you thought was possible. Ready to get started? Join our global Data Intelligence for Clinical Operations (DICO) team as an Operational Data Steward Leader and you’ll be accountable for the strategy and coordination of the E2E governance of clinical operational data: study design characteristics, study stakeholders (study team members, vendors, investigational sites, HCPs…), study milestones and status, study recruitment data. You’ll also present this strategy to Top Management via the DICO Steering Committee. Be part of something exceptional. Our Budapest Hub has been recognized for workplace excellence, innovation, and our commitment to putting people first. See the full list of our awards at the end of this posting. Main responsibilities: 1. Liaise with study teams - Study support for operational data •          Serve as Strategic primary contact for end-users within Clinical Operations answering to any questions, requests from other functions. Coordinate the requests review management of study-specific operational data at study level and / or updates in dictionaries in master data systems, based on customer needs. Understand business needs of study end-users, define or update operational data and associated process and quality rules. •          Coordination of transversal groups to manage Use Cases to align operational players for agile/fast decision making and delivery of common operational deliverables. Ensure cross-functional vetting and awareness of implementation activities across Therapeutic Areas. •          Lead the implementation of the effective solution in addressing quality and consistency measures depending on data criticality, including definition harmonization, investigations and impact analysis for functions using these data. 2. Clinical Operations Data Foundations •          Lead the management of Operational Data Standardization (definition, dictionaries, data flow to consuming systems…) in using common vocabulary for a same concept used by several functions. Supervise the reference data development and cleaning in a harmonized way in systems. •          Drive policy-related actions: Streamline processes and associated quality documents (global SOPs, policies, guidelines…) that describe the management of the operational data and implement new working practices. Define the level of control based on data criticality (ex: Reg transparency… vs internal). •          Recommend data flow optimization, capitalizing on electronic tools, to address new requests and assess their impacts to shorten the cycle time and improve overall quality. Manage regular analysis of information reported from a broad variety of sources. Lead the digital transformation to implement an automatic process (AI, ML, NLP…) linked to the operational data to propose data related evolutions. •          Define and coordinate the monitoring of data governance processes adherence to target model and good use of data in clinical trials managed by Clinical operations (KPI or data quality metrics and deviations from acceptable levels). 3. Train and communicate Support the DICO Head in change management activities to drive a data-driven R&D organization: •          Drive supporting documents for communication, education and trainings related to Operational Data assets •          Organize communications on updates or evolutions, users feedback, exchange of best practices and lessons learned. Promote operational data activities (including new usages) About you Experience: At least 5 years in Clinical Development with background in clinical study management. Background or great interest in databases management. Soft Skills: •          Good communication skills and ability to facilitate common understanding of people with various backgrounds, collaborative spirit •          Strong organizational skills, efficiency in matrix organization. Ability to effectively handle multiple tasks and to prioritize, results oriented •          High level of autonomy and commitment •          Customers & quality focused. Ability to simplify complex processes in developing guidelines and tools •          Flexible and Open-minded, Eager to learn with interest and ability to understand new perimeters •          Problem-solving and decision-making capabilities, with analytical and synthetic spirit. •          Project management skills: able to monitor a process, and lead to progress and results. Ability to anticipate, timely escalate issues and define appropriate action plans. •          Good Knowledge and familiarity with industry standards and practices, clinical development process, international regulatory guidelines and GCP requirements •          Good English Communication level (written and oral) Technical skills: •          Excellent transversal understanding of the Data Flow and Data Management processes in Clinical Development. •          Experienced with clinical data management systems and has a sound understanding of database and programming concepts, database structures, file structures (CTMS and satellites, planning tools…) •          Interest for technical evolutions – Digital-oriented. Up to date knowledge on clinical governance systems such as MDM, Data Catalog and data mapping solutions Education: PharmD or Master’s degree in relevant scientific and/or medical field Language(s): Strong English skills (verbal and written), ability to exchange fluently in a global environment Why choose us? Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally .​ Our mission: to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be for over half a billion consumers worldwide.​ At the core of this mission is our 100+ loved brands , our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and four specialized science and innovation development centers. ​ Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.​ B Corp certified in multiple markets , we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet.​ Find out more about our mission to bring health in your hands at www.opella.com. ACNU Platform Product Owner Our team: Our team focuses on transitioning prescription (Rx) medicines to over-the-counter (OTC) status, driving regulatory approvals, safety assessments, and commercial strategies to expand consumer access. This includes coordinating cross-functional efforts in compliance, marketing, and digital channels to successfully launch OTC products. As the digital organization continues to scale its Ecommerce and ACNU capabilities, this role will play a critical part in shaping and building the core digital infrastructur e, while also establishing effective collaboration models with business stakeholders and other digital functions. Given that Ecommerce capabilities span across Business Solutions, Technology & Architecture, and Data & Analytics, the role requires strong cross-functional coordinatio n. The team acts as the primary digital partner for the business in all areas related to our scope. About the role As Product Owner for the ACNU (Additional Condition for Nonprescription Use) Platform, you own the vision, scope, and delivery of the digital platform enabling the transition of prescription (Rx) medicines to over‑the‑counter (OTC) status. You work across business, compliance, and engineering to turn outcomes into a backlog that ships. This is not a “requirements-only” PO role. You are expected to be hands-on and technical: able to understand and shape cloud architecture decisions, collaborate deeply with DevOps and engineering, and Cybersecurity; as well as with your business counterparts. Main responsabilices: The key job responsibilities of Product Owner ACNU will be: Own and evolve the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for the ACNU platform. Own the backlog, write clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and drive refinement and sprint planning. Lead stakeholder alignment and decision-making across business, compliance, and technical teams. Drive delivery with engineering and DevOps, ensuring quality, security, and operational readiness. Own platform-level integration topics (APIs, data flows, retailer and enterprise dependencies), including risk and dependency management. Ensure the platform uses modern cloud practices (Azure), Git-based delivery (GitHub), and CI/CD automation. Be hands-on technically when needed: troubleshoot with the team, validate architecture choices, and build small solutions or prototypes to accelerate progress. Track progress transparently, drive clear ownership, and escalate early with actionable problem statements. Experience: Proven experience as a Product Owner, Technical Product Owner, or similar role delivering digital products or platforms. Experience working with cloud-based products, ideally on Microsoft Azure. Experience working with Agile teams and tooling (Jira and Confluence or equivalent). Experience in regulated environments, healthcare, or complex enterprise ecosystems is a plus. Experience with platform integrations and cross-team dependencies. Soft skills: Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills, including driving decisions in ambiguous situations. Clear, direct communication and strong writing skills. Ownership mindset, proactive follow-through, and comfort with escalation when needed. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, especially when delivery is blocked by dependencies. Technical skills: Solid understanding of cloud architecture fundamentals (Azure), including security and networking concepts at a practical level. Strong understanding of Git and GitHub workflows (branching, pull requests, reviews, quality gates). Experience with CI/CD (Azure DevOps and or GitHub Actions), automation, and release practices. Ability to work with engineers on troubleshooting using logs and monitoring signals. Familiarity with API-driven platforms, authentication and authorization concepts, and integration patterns. Observability knowledge (Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Grafana or similar) is a plus. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business, or equivalent practical experience. Languages: Advanced English required. Spanish or French preferred. W związku z powyższym chcielibyśmy poinformować Cię jak spółki: ·        Sanofi sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Warszawie przy ul. Marcina Kasprzaka 6, 01-211 Warszawa, lub ·        Opella Healthcare Poland sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Warszawie przy ul. przy ul. Marcina Kasprzaka 6, 01-211 Warszawa, będą przetwarzały Twoje dane osobowe jeżeli zdecydujesz się nam je udostępnić w celu uwzględnienia twojej aplikacji w ramach prowadzonej przez nas rekrutacji. Administrator danych osobowych Z chwilą udostepnienia nam Twoich danych osobowych (dalej jako „Dane Osobowe” ) spółka Sanofi, do której aplikujesz staje się ich Administratorem, co oznacza że będzie decydowała o tym w jakim celu i w jaki sposób Twoje Dane Osobowe są przetwarzane w jej bazie danych. Administratorem będzie zawsze ta spółka do której aplikujesz na stanowisko (zwana dalej również „Administratorem” lub „my”, „nam”, „nas” itp.). Niezależnie od tego, która z wyżej wskazanych spółek Sanofi jest Administratorem, zasady przetwarzania Danych Osobowych w procesie rekrutacji są tożsame. Źródło pozyskania Danych Osobowych Możemy pozyskiwać Twoje Dane Osobowe z następujących źródeł: a.      bezpośrednio od Ciebie (np. gdy sam przesyłasz nam swoją aplikację, odpowiadasz na naszą ofertę pracy, wypełniasz nasz formularz rekrutacyjny, przychodzisz na spotkanie rekrutacyjne); b.      z baz danych prowadzonych przez agencje (firmy rekrutacyjne), w których zarejestrowałeś się jako osoba poszukująca pracy, pod warunkiem, że udzieliłeś zgodę na udostepnienie nam przez taką agencję Twoich Danych Osobowych w celach rekrutacyjnych, c.       od twoich poprzednich pracodawców, jeżeli dobrowolnie zgodzisz się na to abyśmy poprosili ich o przekazanie nam opinii jak oceniali Cię jako pracownika (tzw. referencji), d.      z portali internetowych, w których zamieszczasz publicznie informacje o swoim doświadczeniu zawodowym, wykształceniu, zainteresowaniach, dotychczasowej ścieżce kariery itp. (np. linkedIn). Cel przetwarzania Danych Osobowych Będziemy przetwarzać Twoje Dane Osobowe na potrzeby przeprowadzenia rekrutacji w ramach, której aplikujesz na określone stanowisko pracy. Jeżeli się zgodzisz będziemy przetwarzać Twoje dane także w przyszłych procesach rekrutacyjnych, jeżeli nie zostałeś wybrany do zatrudnienia na stanowisku, na które pierwotnie aplikowałeś. Za Twoją zgodą udostępnimy Twoje Dane Osobowe do innych spółek z Grupy Sanofi, aby one także mogły przedstawiać Ci swoje oferty pracy i zapraszać do udziału w rekrutacjach. Podstawa prawna przetwarzania danych Przetwarzamy Twoje Dane Osobowe zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem UE 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych), zwanym dalej „RODO” działając na podstawie: a.      przepisów prawa pracy, w szczególności Kodeksu pracy, które wskazują jakie dane pracodawca powinien uzyskać od kandydata do pracy (podstawa prawna: art. 6 ust. 1 lit. c i art. 9 ust. 2 lit. b RODO), b.      Twojej zgody na przetwarzanie danych (podstawa prawna: art. 6 ust. 1 lit. a i art. 9 ust. 2 lit a RODO), w przypadku gdy: ·        dobrowolnie przekazujesz nam więcej Danych Osobowych niż wymagają przepisy prawa pracy, ·        udzielasz agencji (firmie) rekrutacyjnej, w której bazie się zarejestrowałeś, na udostepnienie nam Twoich Danych Osobowych w celu uwzględnienia twojej aplikacji w ramach prowadzonej przez nas rekrutacji, ·        udzielasz nam zgodę na przetwarzanie Twoich Danych Osobowych w przyszłych procesach rekrutacyjnych, ·        zgadzasz się abyśmy udostępnili Twoje Dane Osobowe innym spółkom Grupy Sanofi w ich własnych celach rekrutacyjnych. Udzielenie powyższych zgód jest dobrowolne i mogą one zostać wycofane w dowolnym momencie. Zwróć jednak uwagę, że skorzystanie prawa do wycofania udzielonej wcześniej zgody nie będzie miało wpływu na legalność naszych działań, które były prowadzone w oparciu o Twoją zgodę jeszcze zanim została ona wycofana. c.       realizacji naszych prawnie uzasadnionych interesów polegających na umożliwieniu nam w przyszłości obrony przed ewentualnymi roszczeniami z zakresu równego traktowania i dyskryminacji w zatrudnieniu (podstawa prawna: art. 6 ust. 1 lit. f i art. 9 ust. 2 lit. f RODO). Odbiorcy danych Dostęp do Danych Osobowych mogą mieć następujący odbiorcy danych: · upoważnieni pracownicy Administratora oraz usługodawcy (mogą to być spółki z Grupy Sanofi lub zewnętrzni dostawcy), jeżeli  dostęp do danych jest niezbędny takiemu usługodawcy dla realizacji usług świadczonych dla Administratora. W szczególności należą do nich podmioty takie jak agencje (firmy) rekrutacyjne, które szukają dla nas najlepszych kandydatów do pracy lub wspierają nas w takich poszukiwaniach. Jeżeli otrzymaliśmy Twoje dane osobowe od agencji rekrutacyjnej, to w takim przypadku możemy udostępnić tej agencji informacje dotyczące Twojego zatrudnienia w zakresie niezbędnym do rozliczenia wynagrodzenia agencji za pomyślny wynik rekrutacji, jeżeli zostaniesz zatrudniony. Ponadto dostęp do Twoich danych mogą mieć również podmioty dostarczające nam narzędzia i systemy IT wykorzystywane do przetwarzania danych w procesach rekrutacyjnych, w tym dostawcy portali internetowych dla osób poszukujących pracy. Zawsze jednak dostęp do Danych Osobowych mają tylko podmioty, w przypadku których istnieje uzasadnienie takiego dostępu z uwagi na wykonywane zadania i świadczone usługi. Dbamy o to aby nasi pracownicy przechodzili odpowiednie szkolenia z zakresu ochrony danych osobowych poprzez zapoznawanie ich z wewnętrznymi politykami i procedurami ochrony danych lub dedykowane programy szkoleniowe. Wszystkie osoby upoważnione do przetwarzania Danych Osobowych są zobowiązane do zachowania poufności danych i ich zabezpieczenia przed ujawnieniem osobom nieuprawnionym. · podmioty z Grupy Sanofi , którym Dane Osobowe są udostępniane do wykorzystania we własnych procesach rekrutacyjnych, jeżeli udzieliłeś nam zgodę na takie udostepnienie danych. Transfer danych do państw trzecich (państw spoza EOG) Dane Osobowe mogą trafić do odbiorców w dowolnym z krajów, w których Grupa Sanofi prowadzi swoją działalność. Niektórzy z odbiorców danych mogą znajdować się w krajach spoza Europejskiego Obszaru Gospodarczego (EOG), które nie zapewniają takiego samego poziomu ochrony danych osobowych jak kraje należące do EOG. Na taką okoliczność Administrator stosuje odpowiednie mechanizmy mające na celu ochronę Danych Osobowych, w tym w szczególności Wiążące Reguły Korporacyjne Grupy Sanofi albo umowę o przekazaniu danych opartą na standardowych klauzulach umownych przyjętych przez Komisję Europejską. W celu uzyskania dalszych informacji na temat krajów, do których przekazywane są dane lub stosowanych mechanizmów przekazywania danych można skontaktować się z Administratorem na wskazane poniżej dane kontaktowe. Okres przechowywania danych Dane Osobowe będą przechowywane przez okres rekrutacji, a w przypadku niewybranych kandydatów także przez  3 miesiące od jej zakończenia wyłącznie w celu ich wykorzystania w razie potrzeby w rekrutacji na to samo stanowisko np. w przypadku gdy pierwotnie wybrany kandydat zrezygnował z oferty pracy. Po ostatecznym zakończeniu danej rekrutacji możemy jednak zachować Twoje Dane Osobowe na potrzeby obrony przed ewentualnymi roszczeniami z zakresu równego traktowania i dyskryminacji w zatrudnieniu, jednak nie dłużej niż do czasu upływu okresu przedawnienia tych roszczeń, który wynosi 3 lata (w przypadku wszczęcia postępowania przed sądem okres ten ulega jednak przedłużeniu do czasu zakończenia takiego postepowania). Jeżeli natomiast zgodzisz się na przetwarzanie Twoich Danych Osobowych w przyszłych procesach rekrutacyjnych będziemy je przetwarzać w tych celach nie dłużej niż do momentu, gdy wycofasz swoją zgodę . W przypadku, gdy w wyniku rekrutacji zostaniesz zatrudniony, będziemy przetwarzać Twoje Dane Osobowe w ramach procesów zatrudnienia. Szczegółowa informacja na temat przetwarzania danych osobowych pracowników zostanie Ci przedstawiona na etapie zawierania umowy o pracę. Zasady gromadzenia danych Podanie Danych Osobowych jest obowiązkowe w zakresie wskazanym w art. 22¹ § 1 i 4 Kodeksu pracy. Wszelkie dodatkowe informacje podajesz dobrowolnie udzielając zgodę na ich przetwarzanie. Niepodanie danych wymaganych będzie skutkowało odrzuceniem Twojej aplikacji w procesie rekrutacyjnym. Prawa związane z przetwarzaniem Danych Osobowych Jako podmiot danych możesz skorzystać wobec Administratora z następujących praw: a.      prawa do żądania dostępu do swoich Danych Osobowych i uzyskania informacji na temat ich przetwarzania, a w przypadku gdyby były nieprawidłowe ma prawo do żądania ich sprostowania (zgodnie z art. 15 i 16 RODO), b.      prawa do żądania ograniczenia przetwarzania Twoich danych w sytuacjach i na zasadach wskazanych w art. 18 RODO (Każdy podmiot danych może żądać ograniczenia przetwarzania jego danych osobowych na okres weryfikacji ich prawidłowości lub do czasu rozpatrzenia jego sprzeciwu wobec przetwarzania danych. Prawo to przysługuje także w sytuacji gdy zdaniem podmiotu danych przetwarzanie jego danych jest niezgodnie z prawem, lecz nie chce on aby dane te zostały od razu usunięte lub w przypadku gdy dane są mu potrzebne dłużej niż zakładał przyjęty okres przetwarzania, z uwagi na kwestie ustalenia lub obrony roszczeń), c.       prawa do wycofania udzielonej wcześniej zgody na przetwarzanie Danych Osobowych, co jednak nie będzie miało wpływu na legalność przetwarzania Twoich danych, które odbywało się w oparciu o tę przesłankę i miało miejsce przed skorzystaniem przez Ciebie z prawa do wycofania zgody, d.      prawa do żądania usunięcia danych zgodnie z art. 17 RODO („prawo do bycia zapomnianym”), e.      prawa do przeniesienia Danych Osobowych zgodnie z art. 20 RODO, tj. do otrzymania od Administratora swoich danych osobowych w ustrukturyzowanym, powszechnie używanym formacie nadającym się do odczytu maszynowego (przez komputer), a także do żądania ich przekazania do innego administratora danych; Prawo to dotyczy tylko danych, które sam nam dostarczyłeś, przetwarzanych na podstawie Twojej zgody i mających postać elektroniczną, f.       prawa do sprzeciwu wobec dlaszego przetwarzania danych zgodnie z art. 21 RODO. Ponadto masz prawo wnieść w skargę na przetwarzanie Twoich Danych Osobowych przez Administratora do Prezesa Urzędu Ochrony Danych Osobowych (adres: ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warszawa). Dane kontaktowe Administratora oraz jego inspektora ochrony danych Aby skontaktować się z Administratorem w celu skorzystania z wyżej wskazanych praw dotyczących przetwarzania danych osobowych należy odwiedzić stronę internetową: https://www.sanofi.com/en/data-protection-contact W celu skontaktowania się z naszym Inspektorem Ochrony Danych prosimy o przesłanie wiadomości mailowej na adres: iod@sanofi.com Administrator może pozostawić w swoich zasobach Dane Osobowe osoby występującej z wnioskiem lub żądaniem w zakresie niezbędnym do udokumentowania, iż ich rozpatrzenie odbyło się zgodnie z przepisami prawa. Dane te będą przetwarzane nie dłużej niż do czasu przedawnienia roszczeń, co stanowi prawnie uzasadniony interes Administratora, o którym mowa w art. 6 ust. 1 lit. f) RODO. Intitulé du poste : Analyste CQ Lieu : Lyon Gerland Type de poste : permanent, temps plein Horaires : journée À propos du poste Le site de Sanofi Winthrop Industrie – Etablissement Lyon Gerland, situé au cœur du biodistrict de Lyon Gerland, est spécialisé dans la bioproduction et dans l’immunologie. Missions de la PCU FLUX : Prendre en charge les analyses devant être réalisées dans le flux (pour répondre aux impératifs de production ou de temps de stockage des échantillons), effectuer les prélèvements environnementaux de la ZAC Thymoglobuline et participer à la mise en œuvre des autres analyses du laboratoire de microbiologie Ces activités sont à réaliser dans les délais impartis et dans le respect strict des exigences qualité du groupe (BPF, GMP, procédures générales) et des principes de sécurité Réaliser les analyses microbiologiques et les prélèvements environnementaux Exploiter les données et enregistrer des résultats vérifiés, fiables Initier les investigations qualité et prendre en charge les enquêtes laboratoire À propos de Sanofi : Sanofi est une entreprise biopharmaceutique qui innove en R&D et exploite l'IA à grande échelle pour améliorer la vie des gens et créer de la croissance à long terme. Notre compréhension approfondie du système immunitaire – et notre pipeline innovant – nous permet d’inventer des médicaments et des vaccins qui traitent et protègent des millions de personnes dans le monde entier. Ensemble, nous poursuivons les miracles de la science pour améliorer la vie des gens. Principales responsabilités : Exécution des tests analytiques en temps voulu, en veillant au respect délais engagés Exécution de ses tâches conformément aux exigences cGMP et EHS, et aux instructions, procédures, dossiers associés, liés à ces tâches Enregistrement de toutes les données brutes, calculs, informations attendus, liés à ses tâches, pour se conformer aux BPFa et aux exigences d’intégrité des données S’assurer qu’il est formé et qualifié pour les tests analytiques assignés qui nécessitent d’être qualifié Effectuer la revue des données CQ des tests exécutés par d’autres analystes en temps voulu, en veillant au respect des délais engagés Informer son responsable de tout événement de qualité ou EHS (écarts, OOx, etc.) en temps voulu pour s’assurer que l’investigation et l’évaluation de l’impact sont effectuées de manière appropriée Participer activement à toute investigation, lorsqu'il/elle est impliqué(e), afin d'assurer que les investigations et l'évaluation d'impact sont effectuées de manière appropriée Exécution des CAPA assignées liées aux plans de remédiation, améliorations continues Garantir que son laboratoire, ses installations et ses instruments de laboratoire sont maintenus dans un état de qualité et de sécurité permettant de les utiliser de manière appropriée Effectuer des prélèvements environnementaux et des utilités Élaborer des plans de remédiation liés aux écarts de préparation à l’inspection, aux observations, aux écarts, etc. À propos de vous Expérience : Expérience dans le secteur de l’industrie pharmaceutique avec une orientation vers les standards qualité et les bonnes pratiques de fabrication (BPF) Savoir-être et savoir-faire : Rigueur Esprit d'equipe Aisance relationnelle Bonne capacité de communication Formation : Bac +2, Technicien de laboratoire polyvalent ou equivalent Pourquoi nous choisir? Évoluez dans un environnement où vous pouvez grandir, vous épanouir et avoir un réel impact, un lieu de travail qui vous permet de donner le meilleur de vous-même, chaque jour. Identify biomarkers for patient selection, response prediction, target engagement, and clinical outcome correlation. Provide scientific, biomarker and precision medicine focused expertise to pre-clinical projects. About the job This role is responsible for developing and maintaining reliable relationships with local communities across designated therapeutic areas in the Germany. The focus is on implementing community-oriented projects, supporting patient education activities, reducing barriers to clinical trial access, and identifying practices that can advance health equity. The Community Outreach and Engagement Manager will work in partnership with Sanofi-sponsored trial sites to support recruitment and retention activities, collect relevant data, and contribute to building Diversity in Clinical Trials (DICT) capabilities in the German market where this is an emerging field. Important Context: DICT is a less mature concept in Germany and Europe compared to the US market. This role offers the opportunity to help shape and build community engagement approaches appropriate for the European healthcare context. You will receive structured feedback, coaching, and management alignment support as you develop in this role. Understanding of German compliance, code of practice, and integrity policy with regard to engaging patients will be a core competency. Principal Duties and Responsibilities 1. Region-Specific Community Awareness, Outreach, and Engagement Strategy Contribute to the development of country-level engagement strategies tailored to local communities, particularly in markets where DICT is an emerging concept. Work collaboratively with DICT leadership, Clinical Study Units (CSU), local government, public affairs and vendors to understand the local healthcare ecosystem and develop appropriate solutions to address community needs. Activities include: Co-develop community engagement activities and events with cross-functional teams Monitor country-specific metrics and identify culturally appropriate engagement tactics Support local digital/media strategy development Identify and engage trusted messengers, local ambassadors, and potential investigators Facilitate community feedback through focus groups and surveys 2. Community Engagement Implementation, Event Planning and Coordination Plan and coordinate virtual and in-person events to build relationships among local community members and support positive health outcomes. Planning activities include venue research, logistical preparation, and outreach to confirm attendance. 3. Build and Maintain Relationships with Sites and Investigators Develop constructive working relationships with relevant site stakeholders to support productive interactions between patients, sites, Sanofi, and the community. Activities include: Design strategies and tactics to link community engagement activities with the clinical trial sites, in partnership with the CSU. Support processes that influence clinical trial operational performance Promote digital tools and DICT implementation at site level Collate feedback, prioritize issues, and recommend solutions 4. Key Markets and Target Populations Responsible for determining appropriate communities in alignment with stakeholders for outreach engagement, including site diversity champions, local key opinion leaders (KOLs), and trusted messengers. Work with manager and regional team to determine engagement frequency and approach. 5. Vendor and Patient Advocacy Group Coordination Identify and coordinate with local vendors that can support engagement efforts (e.g., mobile health units, pharmacies, marketing agencies). Collaborate with Sanofi Community Alliance Network (SCAN) vendors and other strategic partners to implement local events and activities. 6. Internal Engagement and Stakeholder Coordination Coordinate with internal Sanofi stakeholders (Medical Science Liaisons, Local Study Managers, etc.) based on regional structures and ways of working. You will receive guidance on internal coordination processes and stakeholder mapping specific to your region. 7. Support Recruitment and Retention at Local Level Work closely with Sanofi stakeholders to support sites in identifying potential study participants through community-based and in-office recruitment activities. 8. Site Issue Escalation and Communication Support monitoring teams in communicating and resolving site issues to improve local quality. Help identify site resource and infrastructure gaps that may impact trial conduct. 9. Best Practices and Lessons Learned Act as a local liaison and contribute subject matter expertise on clinical trial optimization based on community feedback. Collaborate with all stakeholders to ensure insights and best practices are documented, communicated, and shared to reduce operational complexities. Onboarding, Coaching & Development Support Structured Onboarding: You will receive comprehensive onboarding covering DICT principles, Sanofi's community engagement approach, relevant therapeutic areas, and the European clinical trial landscape.  Comprehensive compliance training will be provided covering patient engagement ethics, data protection, and regulatory requirements specific to the German/EU market. Manager Feedback and Coaching: Regular coaching sessions with your manager will support your development in this role, particularly in navigating the cultural and operational differences between US and European approaches to diversity in clinical trials. Peer Network: You will connect with the global DICT community of practice to share learnings, challenges, and best practices across regions. Development Opportunities: This role offers significant opportunities for professional growth as you help build emerging DICT capabilities in a key market. Your contributions will directly shape how Sanofi approaches community engagement in Europe.
